definitions.description: Create a durable project task in the filesystem event log. Use for work that should survive sessions and context compaction.
definitions.name: task_create

definitions.description: List ready durable project tasks: open tasks with no open blockers.
definitions.name: task_ready

definitions.description: Show one durable project task with comments and dependencies.
definitions.name: task_show

definitions.description: Atomically claim a durable project task for the current agent.
definitions.name: task_claim

definitions.description: Close a durable project task with an optional reason.
definitions.name: task_close

definitions.description: Add a durable comment to a project task.
definitions.name: task_comment

definitions.description: Add or remove a dependency between durable project tasks.
definitions.name: task_link

definitions.description: Store a durable typed project memory in the filesystem event log.
definitions.name: memory_remember

definitions.description: Update an existing durable typed project memory by id. Omitted fields keep their current values.
definitions.name: memory_update

definitions.description: Delete one durable typed project memory by id.
definitions.name: memory_delete

definitions.description: Summarize durable typed project memory counts by kind, scope, and tag.
definitions.name: memory_stats

definitions.description: Build compact durable project context from tasks and memories for session start or compaction recovery.
definitions.name: prime_context
